leah: Heads-up: coordinated release window Fri 01:30-04:30 UTC. Order proposal: router prewarm -> api canary -> runtime roll -> console. Need concise rollback play and who watches what.

omar: router first to validate header-split and route-table. Canaries: router 1%->10%->50%->full, api 1%->20%->full, runtime 2%->25%->75%->full.

felix: pins and fallbacks: router header-split v1.21 (rollback v1.20), api v2.42 (fallback v2.41), runtime v8.3 (fallback v8.2). No kernel flips during window.

leah: preflight running: deploybot please run standard checks and report schema-compat.

deploybot: PRE-FLIGHT: config-lock OK, infra-capacity OK, dep-graph OK, schema-compat WARNING (console telemetry optional field).

omar: router risk from previous header-swaps: KV misses -> runtime cache churn. Recommend bump router cache TTL to 25m and set runtime eviction to conservative for 1h post-roll.

leah: adding TTL bump and conservative eviction to runbook. auto thresholds for rollback?

felix: will rehearse these in staging. 15m soak between waves, hold progression on any warning.
